full_reference_rule: Each model uses the explicitly selected full UID, setup and backend in uid_catalog; other full baselines are distinct.
host_label_scope: host is the accelerator setup label H8/H10/DeepX, not the x86 controller or separate measurement source. setup_id identifies the configured device.

interval_policy.end: After last measured completion and full pipeline drain
interval_policy.energy_per_completion: Integral of measured power over the same exact interval / N_completed
interval_policy.missing_clock_or_energy_interval_binding: Retain raw attempt but reject paired rate-energy claim
interval_policy.start: Immediately before first admitted measured request
